label_policy: Hand-authored synthetic project evidence. Grade 2 directly answers; grade 1 supports the answer; unlisted documents are nonrelevant. Not a representative production corpus.

documents.text: The website navbar collapses into a hamburger menu below 768 pixels. Keyboard focus stays inside the expanded menu.
Responsive header navigation uses a tablet breakpoint of 768px and an accessible menu toggle.
The HTTP response header Content-Security-Policy restricts browser resource loading; it does not control page navigation.
Rotate refresh tokens on every use and invalidate the entire token family when an old refresh token is replayed.
Session theft mitigation uses single-use refresh credentials and family-wide revocation on reuse.
Refresh the dashboard every minute to show recent token usage statistics.
SQLite WAL supports simultaneous readers and one writer. Do not store a writable WAL database on a network filesystem.
Keep canonical.sqlite on local disk. Shared agents must connect through the service rather than opening database files.
The network dashboard shows filesystem disk-usage charts and database icons.
Reject coordinator controls carrying an old Nexus epoch after leadership changes. A lease does not grant permanent authority.
A new coordinator fences stale commands from its predecessor using monotonically increasing authority generations.
Historical Nexus messages retain a coordinator-at-send-time badge in the timeline.
Deleting a memory hides it from reads but old backups, WAL pages, and adapter spools can retain its bytes. Verify retained copies separately.
Logical deletion is not physical erasure. Compaction does not sanitize historical snapshots or remote provider storage.
Hide the delete button when a memory has no selected evidence source.
After an ambiguous model turn, hold execution for operator reconciliation. Never repeat a potentially completed external side effect blindly.
A durable intent with an unknown outcome blocks automatic restart until exact completion evidence is available.
Retry failed CSS downloads with exponential backoff to improve the browser loading experience.
The canonical_retention_guard function validates merged candidate ownership before local Git retention.
Use canonical_retention_guard with the canonical project binding, not merely Git ancestry.
A generic retention guard can hide old chart labels without changing Git repositories.
Los mensajes privados solo son visibles para participantes autorizados. No publique su contenido en el tablero compartido.
Private direct messages must not be copied into a public board without explicit disclosure permission.
The shared board supports Spanish names and public multilingual announcements.

queries.text: At what screen width does the site menu switch to a compact button?
How do we contain stolen long-lived login credentials if an attacker reuses one?
Can workers share the writable canonical database over a network drive?
How is a replaced leader prevented from issuing delayed commands?
Does removing a record guarantee its contents are gone from every retained copy?
Should a worker repeat a tool operation if it crashed before receiving the result?
¿Puedo copiar una conversación privada al tablero público?
